2026-10-23-51.title: Project chats for the Admin
2026-10-23-51.body: As the Admin, you see the unread count and get pushes of the project chats of your own projects. In other project chats, you see only the messages that name you. Pick All messages in the menu of a chat to see all of it.

2026-10-23-50.title: Fewer pushes
2026-10-23-50.body: A project chat now sends you a push only when a message names you. In the menu of each chat, Notify me sets All messages or Only when I am named. Madar sends no push for a chat that you already read. A 👍 or ✅ on a message answers it.

2026-10-23-23.title: Drop files into a chat
2026-10-23-23.body: Drag files from your computer and drop them on an open chat, or paste a picture into the message box. Each file shows how much of it went up. Nothing goes until you press Send.

2026-10-23-22.title: A calmer chat
2026-10-23-22.body: The chat keeps your place now. It opens at the first new message, under a thin New line. New messages do not move the chat while you read older ones; the round Newest button takes you down. The messages of one person in 5 minutes sit together. A message that names you has a soft color. A chat counts as read only while you look at it. Web addresses are links, and a half-written message stays after you close the tab.

2026-10-23-21.title: Files & Links
2026-10-23-21.body: Now the links of a project are in the Files & Links tab, above the files. You add a file or a link from one button, Add. The About panel does not show the links.

2026-10-23-20.title: The ring on Home
2026-10-23-20.body: The ring next to the date on Home now says what it counts: how many of your tasks for today are done.

2026-10-23-19.title: A restart reminder
2026-10-23-19.body: The planned restart of a paused project is a reminder. On that day the person who paused the project and its leader get a notice: resume the project or set a new date.

2026-10-23-18.title: Tasks with no lead
2026-10-23-18.body: The Workload of the Dashboard has a No lead row. It counts the open tasks that nobody leads, for each week. Press a number to see the tasks.

2026-10-23-17.title: Reasons in task chats
2026-10-23-17.body: The reason for a new date or a reopened task shows as a short line in the task chat, not as a message from a person.

2026-10-23-16.title: Your tasks in the morning email
2026-10-23-16.body: The morning email now lists your open tasks: past due, today and this week, with the project of each task.

2026-10-23-15.title: AI agents set stage dates
2026-10-23-15.body: An AI agent of a project leader can now set the start and end dates of a stage, as the leader does in the Schedule tab.

2026-10-23-14.title: Apply a template to your project
2026-10-23-14.body: Now the leader of a project can apply a template to an ongoing project. Open the project menu and press Apply a template. Madar adds the stages and tasks that the project does not have yet, from today.

2026-10-23-13.title: Who changes a role
2026-10-23-13.body: Now only the Admin changes the role of a person. Management can read a role, but cannot change it.

2026-10-23-1.title: The project list
2026-10-23-1.body: Now the project list shows who works on each project. It shows 3 pictures, then a number such as +2 for the rest.

2026-10-23-2.title: Your profile photo
2026-10-23-2.body: Now a photo with a see-through background shows your glow behind it. Upload the photo again to see the glow.

2026-10-23-3.title: A new calendar
2026-10-23-3.body: Madar has its own calendar on a computer. Turn the mouse wheel to move one month. Press the month name to jump to another month or year. Press Today to come back.

2026-10-23-4.title: Archive a chat
2026-10-23-4.body: Now you can archive a chat. Point at the chat and press the three dots, or swipe the chat on a phone. A new message brings it back. The row Archived is under the search field.

2026-10-23-5.title: Group chats
2026-10-23-5.body: Now you can make a group chat with 2 or more people. Press New message, then New group. Press the number of people under the name of a group to see who is in it. You can send a file or a photo in any chat. A photo in a chat shows as a picture; press it to see it large and download it. In a chat, Arabic text runs from the right and English text from the left, also while you type.

2026-10-23-6.title: Agents read your chats
2026-10-23-6.body: Now your AI agent can read your chats and list the chats that wait for your reply. The AI agent of a colleague in a chat can read the messages of that chat. The agent of a person who is not in the chat cannot read it.

2026-10-23-7.title: Sub-companies
2026-10-23-7.body: Now the Admin can add the sub-companies of the office, each with a logo. A project picks its sub-company, and the logo shows beside the project picture.

2026-10-23-8.title: The project on the map
2026-10-23-8.body: Now you can pin the project on a map in Edit project. Search a place by name or paste a map link. The Dashboard has a Map tab. It shows the street map in Madar colors, with all the pins. The Location of a project is its pin. Madar takes the address from the map. The About panel of a project shows its place on a map. A button on each map opens it full screen.

2026-10-23-9.title: Open space
2026-10-23-9.body: Now Open space shows the office as a mind map of projects, stages and tasks. Open it from the Dashboard.

2026-10-23-10.title: Project templates
2026-10-23-10.body: Now a stage keeps its start and length after you add a task. The Admin can drag the stages of a project template, copy a template, and see its timeline. Each task and stage has a Waits for picker. The Admin can also send an update to the projects made from a template.

2026-10-23-11.title: Roles and rights
2026-10-23-11.body: Now the Admin can make a custom role and choose its rights.

2026-10-23-12.title: The office report
2026-10-23-12.body: Now a person with the report right can ask an AI agent for the full office report.
